method: Saved prefab in ForkliftHandlingValidation's isolated Rig, production 0.005 second PhysX step. Settle 3 s, full raise command 20 s, neutral 1 s. Cache all three mechanism bodies relative to chassis, call explicit ResetVehicle translated 7 m in X and -9 m in Z with 83 degree yaw. Compare immediate world poses with the expected rigid pose delta, resume physical simulation for 3 s, then measure relative pose drift and retained lift travel. No load is attached or repositioned.

checks.name: full extension recovery preserves mechanism
checks.expectation: Translated and rotated explicit recovery preserves all moving body poses, then resumes stable physical simulation.

measurements.name: lift travel after recovery and simulation
